names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 octombrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Φλωρέντιος», with the rank word left off.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2317, «Флорентий Солунянин, мч.», with the rank word left off. «Солунянин» is the man of Thessalonica; the day line gives «Флорентия» alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 октября ст. ст. — «Мч. Флорентия (I-II).»
source.note: No rank is read onto this line. The day prints two icons and both stand in its first paragraph: a polyeleos before the Iveron icon of the Theotokos, and the plain service, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all, before the company of 251. Neither reaches a later line. The day's readings do name one further polyeleos service, and it is Thaddeus of Tver's, not this one's.

attestations.note: The Russian gives this folder its first date and then disagrees with itself about it — «I-II» on the day line against «+ II век» at the end of its own life. Its life is three sentences and says what he did: a native of Thessalonica, he rebuked the darkness of idol-worship without fear, brought many to the light of the true knowledge of God and taught faith in Christ and the doing of God's will; for that the pagans put him to cruel torments and then burned him.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 13 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Florentie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Φλωρέντιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: «Ο Άγιος Φλωρέντιος ζούσε στη Θεσσαλονίκη, απ' όπου και καταγόταν», a preacher of the Gospel denounced to the pagan governor of Thessalonica, beaten, his flesh torn, and thrown into the fire. The page gives no year and no reign at all, so no `dates` object is proposed, and it prints no hymn. The corpus's `florentius-of-nursia` is another man on other days. **Two entries of this same day point at this page** — «Άγιος Μαρτύροχος» `/2736/` and «Άγιος Διοκλητιανός» `/2741/` both say their memory stands with Florentius — and both carry saint.gr's own «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence and are refused; nothing of either is written onto this folder. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on this page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: One page disagreeing with itself is read exactly as two churches disagreeing are. days.pravoslavie.ru's day line prints «Мч. Флорентия (I-II)» and its own life for him closes «(+ II век)», the second century alone. Nothing chooses between them, so the interval carries both. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives a date, and this folder held none.
